description: Status of an order and its USDC payment (state, received, confirmations, refunds). usdc.remaining is an amount to send only when usdc.can_topup is true, or when state is waiting (then it is the one full amount). If can_topup is false after a payment was seen, remaining is omitted: do not send a second transfer. Wraps GET /api/order/{id}. status: pending, processing, paid, pending_review, expired, cancelled, late_paid, refund_pending, refunded, failed.
name: get_order_status
title: Order status
